description: n1ql-auditing.md describes how to configure and read SQL++ audit records across 241 lines with no edition marker, while server/current/learn/security/auditing.md - the page it links to for the general description of auditing - carries an ENTERPRISE EDITION badge. The gate is one hop away and invisible to a reader arriving from a search engine or an LLM index. The only occurrence of the string 'enterprise' anywhere on the page is inside a sample User-Agent string, 'Couchbase Query Workbench (5.1.0-1434-enterprise)', which is an artefact of a copied example rather than a statement about availability.
